comment: Corrections to the Grand Steinway B takes at G#5, which play G#5 and A5, from build b14 of this bank: a short noise just after the blow, which the takes around them do not carry, is reduced. For each take, one entry per channel: before_sha256 is the hash of the 16-bit words the build stores for that channel without these numbers, start is the frame they start at, and add is what is added to each word from there. The recordings are from the Versilian Community Sample Library (Versilian Studios), CC0 1.0; these numbers are of no use without them.
